hero.title: Language Courses in Sweden for Indian Students

Some university courses are available only to enrolled international students or researchers, while other programmes have residency or local eligibility requirements.

overview: For Indian students planning to study, work or live in Sweden, **Swedish Language Courses in Sweden** can be a useful way to develop communication skills and understand local culture.
Through **Edu Hawk worldwide** study abroad guidance, students can explore language-learning options and understand the eligibility, fees and application requirements.

universities.name: \. Stockholm University
universities.desc: Stockholm University offers Swedish language courses for international students and researchers, with options ranging from beginner-level learning to more advanced communication. ![][image1] These courses are generally intended for international students and researchers affiliated with the university. They may not be available to all external applicants.

universities.name: \. Umeå University
universities.desc: Umeå University provides Swedish language courses for international students who want to develop basic communication skills or prepare for further studies. ![][image2] Course availability depends on the semester and student category. The university has stated that Swedish courses are not available for exchange students in Spring 2027, so applicants should check the latest course information.

universities.name: \. Uppsala University
universities.desc: International students at Uppsala University's Campus Gotland may find introductory and semester-based Swedish courses focused on everyday communication. Eligibility, course fees and availability depend on the particular course and the student's university status. ![][image3] **Important:** University language courses may have restrictions based on student status, exchange agreements or university affiliation. Always confirm whether external applicants can register before applying.

items.q: Can Indian students apply for Language Courses in Sweden?
items.a: Yes, Indian students with qualifying credentials meeting English language proficiency (IELTS/TOEFL) and academic prerequisites can apply to recognized universities in Sweden.

items.q: What is the medium of instruction for Language Courses in Sweden?
items.a: Most master's and international bachelor's degree programmes are taught entirely in English for international students across Swedish universities.

items.q: What are the typical tuition fees for Language Courses in Sweden?
items.a: Tuition fees for international students generally range between SEK 80,000 and SEK 150,000 per year, depending on the institution and level of study.

items.q: Can international students work while studying in Sweden?
items.a: Yes, non-EU international students holding a valid Swedish residence permit for higher education are permitted to work alongside their studies without a fixed hours limitation during term time.
